preview: This episode looks at why one office can feel different for different employees. We will ask what people need from a work space, and why a seating policy can shape how the workday feels.
comment_1: Listen for where each employee chooses to work.
comment_2: People choose different places to work. Why can the same office feel safe to one person and give another a feeling of freedom?
comment_3: This story shows that people can experience the same office in very different ways. Next, we will hear two views about what a desk means to the person using it.
comment_4: The two voices show different needs at work. One values having a regular place, while the other values being able to move and choose. Now, let’s bring these views together in the closing summary.
